tasks.title: Repository inventory and evidence map
tasks.objective: Inventory repository state and map claims to accepted evidence.

tasks.title: Evidence taxonomy and completion rules
tasks.objective: Define evidence levels and completion rules used by canonical checkpoints.

tasks.title: Reconcile product vision and stale claims
tasks.objective: Reconcile product vision, roadmap, status, and documentation so claims match current accepted evidence without advancing blocked checkpoints.
acceptance_criteria: One bounded outcome has explicit inputs and outputs.
Relevant tests and the full quality gate pass.
Generated artifacts and manifests are inspected.
Sources remain unchanged and managed outputs pass integrity checks.
Decisions, failures, versions, and remaining real-world validation are recorded.
Only the active canonical checkpoint advances.
README, product specification, project charter, implementation plan, status, handoff, and sprint state contain no contradictory completion claims.

tasks.title: Canonical project-control documents
tasks.objective: Maintain canonical planning and control documents.

tasks.title: Ordered database migrations and restore
tasks.objective: Replace implicit schema upgrades with tested ordered migrations, preflight backup, integrity checks, and restore drill.
acceptance_criteria: Ordered migrations replace implicit schema upgrades.
Restore drill proves recovery from the preflight backup.
Focused and full quality gates pass.
